{"id":"JMAP-9f05","title":"Workspace design: harmonize MemoryBackend test-fixture helpers (with_account, seed_object) across extension-server siblings","description":"The canonical jmap-mail-server::MemoryBackend exposes only register_account(&Id). The siblings jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-contacts-server, and jmap-filenode-server all expose additional builder/seeder helpers: with_account(&str) for builder-style chaining and seed_object(account_id: &str, type_name: &str, id: &str, value: Value) for fixture setup.

JMAP-qz9v.25 flagged this as a type-idiom inconsistency:
- Test-fixture surface: &str (with_account, seed_object)
- Trait/production surface: &Id (account_exists, create_object, etc.)
- Different idiom for equivalent ops.

The bead's two options:
(a) Drop with_account / seed_object from extension siblings; use register_account everywhere. Test ergonomics regress.
(b) Add with_account / seed_object to the canonical mail-server (and any other siblings that lack them).

Decide once on whether &str or &Id is the canonical fixture-helper parameter type, then sweep across all 7 extension-server siblings to match.

P3 because the test-fixture surface is gated behind feature = 'memory' (off by default), the inconsistency is observable only to fixture-writers, and either resolution is a small breaking change to the test surface (not the public production API).

Cross-references:
- JMAP-qz9v.25 (the originating bead, contacts-server scope)
